libunibreak

Tag: libunibreak_6_1
Commit: 304585d8e2d63187507368d612c3d5fff1486368
License: zlib (see LICENSE)

Vendored files (src/): linebreak.c/h, linebreakdata.c, linebreakdef.c/h, graphemebreak.c/h,
graphemebreakdata.c, graphemebreakdef.h, unibreakbase.c/h, unibreakdef.c/h, emojidef.c/h,
eastasianwidthdef.c/h, as listed in docs/tasks/T-29.md, all unmodified.

Three files beyond the task sheet's literal list were also vendored because the listed files
need them to link/build:

- indicconjunctbreakdata.c/indicconjunctbreakdef.h and emojidata.c and eastasianwidthdata.c are
  #included by graphemebreak.c/emojidef.c/eastasianwidthdef.c respectively (data tables compiled
  as part of the including .c file, not separate translation units).
- linebreakdata.c (the `lb_prop_supplementary`/`lb_prop_bmp` tables `linebreak.c` declares
  `extern` and calls into, per `linebreakdef.h`) is, unlike the files above, its own separate
  translation unit -- nothing #includes it -- so text/CMakeLists.txt's `unibreak` target compiles
  it directly alongside linebreak.c/linebreakdef.c.

wordbreak.c/h and wordbreakdata.c are NOT vendored: nothing in this task uses libunibreak's
word-break API (only set_linebreaks_utf8 and set_graphemebreaks_utf8, per
docs/design/07-text.md §7.3 steps 7-8).
